rule.A: 1 - mean(FC_TP_rep)/n_slots; FC baseline 3 reps/task with S3/S4 gold-branch injection, fixed seeds; PD data excluded
rule.B_reachable: dist_to_terminal(f)>=2 AND exists join (fan_in>=2) in {f} ∪ downstream_closure(f)
rule.B: |reachable failure nodes| / |failure nodes|; failure node = attributed node of any slot missed in >=1 FC rep; B=None if no failure nodes
rule.O: A*B; if B is None then O=0.0 (no failure space => no reachable gain)
rule.slot_attribution: slot['node'] if present else unique extract node carrying slot['doc'] else terminal (fallback flagged)
rule.grounding: rule derived from V5 mechanism narrative (deep restructuring acts on join structure >=2 hops from terminal); NOT fit to V5 outcome labels; no tunable parameters

self_test: 14/14 pass at freeze time (11 synthetic + 3 E06 real-fixture)
discipline: frozen BEFORE any V6 FC/PD data; V5 transparency check (below) is reported unmodified and cannot trigger rule changes without operator sign-off as protocol deviation

transparency_check_post_freeze.when: 2026-11-09, after code freeze; read-only; no rule change permitted without operator sign-off
transparency_check_post_freeze.method: frozen rule applied to 10/12 V5 packages (E08/ZIJING packages not found by glob); B_pot = rule applied to ALL slot-attributed nodes (upper-bound proxy) because V5 freeze lacks slot-level FC hit matrices; A from V5 fc_tp means

interpretation.A: discriminates V5 gain classes sharply (HIGH/MEDIUM/ZERO ordered) — consistent with V5 condition 1 (FC failure space)
interpretation.B_pot: NO discrimination on the proxy (HIGH 0.200 < MEDIUM 0.333); ZED counterexample (B_pot=0 but observed HIGH gain). Caveat: proxy over all slot nodes, not actual failure nodes; V6 will compute B on real FC failure nodes — a different quantity. Weak evidence against the rule, not proof of invalidity
interpretation.implication: risk that the O=A*B interaction primary test is underpowered if B lacks variance or mechanism fit; recommend operator consider prereg amendment BEFORE any V6 data: pre-specify A-median-split interaction as a secondary moderator test (A already carries most discriminative signal)
